channel.title: Interpretable Machine Learning Lab
channel.description: The Interpretable Machine Learning Lab at Duke University, led by Cynthia Rudin. We build models that people can actually understand — sparse decision rules, interpretable neural networks, and dimensionality reduction methods that preserve real structure.

item.title: Understanding PaCMAP
item.description: An interactive tour of PaCMAP — a dimensionality-reduction method that preserves both local and global structure, with an animated mammoth, a Fashion-MNIST comparison, and a seed-stability test against t-SNE and UMAP.
